title: ModelList
description: Params out for GET /api/models: every GLB the preview server can serve, newest first.

dir.description: Absolute path of the directory being served.

id.description: Stable URL-safe handle for this model: the file stem, folded to [A-Za-z0-9._-]. Accepted by ?id= on the viewer page and on GET /api/models, so a tool can hand a caller a link to one asset.

name.description: File name, also accepted by ?model= and ?id=.

uri.description: Path the browser fetches the bytes from, served as model/gltf-binary.

modifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC mtime. The list is sorted by this, newest first.

triangles.description: Read from the GLB. Absent when the file could not be parsed.

animations.description: Clip names carried by the file, in file order. Absent when it has none, so the viewer can offer motion without downloading the asset first.

joints.description: Joints in the first skin. Absent when the file has no skin.

readable.description: false when the file exists but does not parse as a GLB.

supersedes.description: File names this entry replaced in the listing. A rigged asset is the mesh it was rigged from with a skeleton added, so listing both puts the same character on screen twice. The dropped file is named here, is still on disk, and is still servable by name.

source.description: The image this mesh was reconstructed from, when one sits next to it. Paired by name: <stem>-r<res>.glb comes from <stem>.png. Absent when there is no match.

uri.description: Path the browser fetches the image from.

width.description: Present for PNG, read from the IHDR.
